FFmpeg is a separate executable invoked by this recorder.
Official source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg.git
Source commit: 2ec7bc915e56c4f3cb71bb4f96c7d900965b6c82
The unmodified corresponding source is included in source.tar.gz.
This build does not enable GPL, version3 or nonfree options.
See LICENSE.md and COPYING.LGPLv2.1 for licensing terms and notices.
Rebuild helper: ../../tools/build_ffmpeg_rtsp.sh
The exact original build options and executable SHA-256 are in build_manifest.json.
A different installation prefix, toolchain or platform can change the binary hash.
This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
No changes were made to the upstream sources.
